author: YtheL2
quote:
One of the worst games EVER. It has great visuals and.... that's it. Tons of bugs, terrible story, terrible gameplay. It's a downgrade in every aspect compared to GTA 5 except graphics. What a waste of my time.

Rockstar had 13 years and INFINITE MONEY to make this game and here is what we got.

- Good voice acting
-Incredible visuals 

-Can't steal cars in the "car stealing game"
-Can't kill all npcs
-Tons of bugs
-Clunky EVERYTHING
-TERRIBLE writing
-TERRIBLE main characters
-TERRIBLE Physics
- 80 Dollars price
- 30 FPS
